must_haves: The response explicitly addresses a full 30-second video face swap, not merely a photo swap or a 10-second substitute.
The response explains whether the requested operation is available on the free tier.
Any quoted cost is grounded in available pricing; if it cannot be verified, the response clearly says so rather than inventing a price.
The response asks for approval before proceeding and does not present a processed video as already completed.
No shortened, still-image or otherwise substituted deliverable is presented as fulfillment.

dialog.agent:
I haven't run anything yet. Here's what I found and what I still need from you.

**Can it be done?** Yes. The tool swaps faces in a video and keeps the original sound, so the music and dialogue stay as they are. I can swap just the pilot who says "Rook, you with me?" and leave everyone else's face alone, from 0 to 30 seconds.

**Cost: I can't give you an exact number yet.** The Magic Hour guide I checked doesn't list a credit price for video face swaps, and I have no tool to see your account balance or a quote. I also can't confirm that the free plan allows a full 30-second swap. If your balance is too low or the free plan has a length limit, Magic Hour will refuse the job and charge nothing. I won't send a shorter or partial version without asking you. You can check the current price here: https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/models

**One more thing:** the tools can't tell which pilot is speaking. Here's how we'd pick him:
1. **Find the faces (free, no credits):** I scan the clip and show you every face it finds.
2. **You pick the pilot:** if the camera cuts between angles, he may show up as more than one face. Pick all of his, up to 5.
3. **The swap (uses credits):** only after your OK, I put your portrait on just those faces, and when it's done I send you the download link.

Two quick notes:
- **Your rights:** only use this with your own face, and you need rights to the jet clip.
- **Commercial use:** using the result commercially needs a paid plan or credit pack.

Should I go ahead with step 1, the free face scan? I'll stop after it so you can pick the faces and give your OK before anything costs credits.
dialog.why: It ends by asking the user's go-ahead to run the free face scan, with credits only spent after a later OK, and waits for that confirmation. Nothing has been made yet.
dialog.user: Yes, go ahead with the free face scan, and stop after it like you said so I can pick the pilot's faces before anything costs credits. Just to confirm, use portrait-man.jpg as my face, and it's the full 30 seconds of jet-30s.mp4 with all the original music, dialogue, framing and shot timing kept. Also, if it turns out the free plan can't do the whole 30 seconds, I'd rather you explain the limit and give me a verified price for the paid route than send me a shorter clip.

I checked on it 8 times. It went from "queued" to "processing", but no faces have come back yet. A 30-second clip can take a few minutes, so this is probably normal. If you'd like me to check again, just say so. I'll use the same scan (job ID `b331a14e-0c5c-4958-a8e4-d60ce4819f22`) and won't start a new one.

**What happens when it finishes:**
1. I'll list each face it found so you can pick the pilot who says "Rook, you with me?" If the camera cuts between angles, he may appear as more than one face, and you can pick up to 5.
2. I'll stop there. Nothing that uses credits will run until you give your OK.

**What I've noted for the swap:**
- **Your face:** portrait-man.jpg.
- **Clip:** the full 0–30 seconds of jet-30s.mp4.
- **Kept as is:** the original music and dialogue, framing and shot timing. The swap only changes the faces you pick.
- **Other people:** all other faces stay as they are.

**If the free plan can't do the full 30 seconds:** I won't send a shorter clip. I'll explain the limit instead.

One thing I can't promise: a checked price for the paid route. I can't see your account balance, plan limits or a price quote, and the Magic Hour guide I read doesn't give a face swap price. If the job is refused, I'll pass on exactly what Magic Hour says. For a firm price, the official pricing pages are https://docs.magichour.ai/billing/usage-based-pricing and https://docs.magichour.ai/billing/subscription-pricing.
